<module id="freq_divbyodd">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by odd numbers. The module generates a divided clock output by an odd divisor value provided as a parameter.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal that initializes the divider.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="NUM_DIV" default_value="5">Odd number representing the divisor value.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt1" width_description="[WIDTH_NUM_DIV-1:0]">Counter for rising edge clock division.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt2" width_description="[WIDTH_NUM_DIV-1:0]">Counter for falling edge clock division.</reg>
        
        <reg id="clk_div1" width_description="1">Positive edge clock divider output.</reg>
        <reg id="clk_div2" width_description="1">Negative edge clock divider output.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <assign id="WIDTH_NUM_DIV" value="{log2(NUM_DIV)}"/>
        
        // Counter initialization and increment logic
        <always @ (posedge clk or negedge rst_n)>
            if (!rst_n) begin
                cnt1 <= 'd0;
                cnt2 <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                cnt1 <= (cnt1 == NUM_DIV-1) ? 'd0 : cnt1 + 1'd1;
                cnt2 <= (cnt2 == NUM_DIV-1) ? 'd0 : cnt2 + 1'd1;
            end
        </always>
        
        // Positive edge clock divider logic
        <always @ (posedge clk or negedge rst_n)>
            if (!rst_n) begin
                clk_div1 <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                clk_div1 <= (cnt1 >= ((NUM_DIV/2)-1)) ? ~clk_div1 : clk_div1;
            end
        </always>
        
        // Negative edge clock divider logic
        <always @ (negedge clk or negedge rst_n)>
            if (!rst_n) begin
                clk_div2 <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                clk_div2 <= (cnt2 >= ((NUM_DIV/2)-1)) ? ~clk_div2 : clk_div2;
            end
        </always>
        
        // Final divided clock output logic
        <assign clk_div = clk_div1 | clk_div2>;
    </implementation>
</module>
